Festival tickets

FESTIVAL TICKET – GENERAL CAMPING
Buy now

The Festival Ticket – General Camping is valid on all three days of the event, from June 4 through June 6, 2027, during the respective opening hours, and includes access to the General Camping areas as well as parking in the designated parking areas. The ticket also includes free use of public transportation operated by the Greater Nuremberg Transport Association (VGN).

Our camping and parking areas are open from Thursday, June 3, 2027, at 9:00 a.m. until Monday, June 7, 2027, at 10:00 a.m.

The ticket is valid per person.

FESTIVAL TICKET – GREEN CAMPING
Buy now

The Festival Ticket – Green Camping is valid on all three days of the event, from June 4 through June 6, 2027, during the respective opening hours, and includes access to the Green Camping areas as well as parking in the designated parking areas. Green Camping focuses on nature conservation and waste separation. In addition, quiet hours are in effect from 1:00 a.m. to 8:00 a.m. The ticket also includes free use of public transportation operated by the Greater Nuremberg Transport Association (VGN).
Our camping and parking areas are open from Thursday, June 3, 2027, at 9:00 a.m. until Monday, June 7, 2027, at 10:00 a.m.

The ticket is valid per person.
